queries_run: Celsius Holdings Pepsi customer concentration credit rating downgrade 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：2025 年對 Pepsi 銷售占總營收 43.2%，Pepsi 應收占總應收 46.2%；失去 Pepsi 可能造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: In 2025, sales to Pepsi constituted 43.2% of our total revenue. As of December 31, 2025, receivables from Pepsi represented 46.2% of our total receivables. The loss of Pepsi or Pepsi's affiliates as our customers could significantly impact our operations, potentially resulting in a material adverse effect on our financial results.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 2026 Q3 10-Q（申報 2026-11-05）集中度表：Pepsi 占前九個月營收 61.3%、應收 58.5%（WebFetch 摘要，無逐字原文，列為線索）。未查到 2026 年信用評等調降或 Pepsi 財務惡化的來源；S&P 發行人評等 BB-（日期未確認）。
